scope: Written scenario/fixture expectations only; not acceptance receipts, application tests or empirical gold.

scenarios.title: ZIP first-use with only an LLM key
scenarios.fixture: Source ZIP without .git; DeepSeek key present; speech key absent; local model cache initially empty.
scenarios.positive: Explicit local speech setup downloads only its selected model assets with actual progress/digests; retry preserves workspace; after setup the one-button generated exercise is usable.
scenarios.negative: No Azure-key demand on the selected local path, invisible backend fallback, corpus prerequisite, account form or fake ready audio.
scenarios.oracle: Independent frozen input, expected artifacts/state and registered mathematics; model agreement alone is not the oracle.

scenarios.title: Settings and effective profiles

scenarios.positive: Freeze actual default/override profile, prompt/schema/budget and speech selection before each operation; show credential presence only.
scenarios.negative: Changing Settings does not change an in-flight attempt, reveal a key or silently substitute another model.
